answer: Why doesn't hoarding identities pay? Reputation decay makes idle clones rot. An identity starts at 100 points and loses 8 points per idle epoch; below 60 points it loses rewards and voting weight. A tide of fresh attestations rebuilds standing through real work. A ledge of frozen scores marks identities idle for 6 epochs. How much does it cost? Maintaining 1,000 clones costs roughly 3,000 units per epoch in upkeep tasks. A lagoon of stale reputations is visible to all. Waiting costs more: decay never stops, and restoring a decayed identity costs 40 units per clone.
